zh: 这个咖喱很辣吗？
en: Is the curry very {spicy|hot}?

zh: 鸡肉中间还是生的。
en: The chicken is still {raw|uncooked|pink} in the middle.

zh: 我喜欢烤猪肉上那层脆脆的皮。
en: I love the {crispy|crunchy|crisp} skin on roast pork.

zh: 上飞机前我不想吃太腻、太难消化的一餐。
en: I don't want a {heavy|rich} meal before the flight.

zh: 这个巧克力蛋糕味道很浓很腻，我只能吃一小块。
en: The chocolate cake is very {rich}; I can only eat a small piece.

zh: 羊肉炖得很嫩，一碰就脱骨了。
en: The lamb was so {tender} it fell off the bone.

zh: 牛排太老了，嚼不动，也很难切。
en: The steak was {tough|chewy} and hard to cut.

zh: 这里的鱼总是很新鲜。
en: The fish here is always {fresh}.

zh: 这面包不新鲜了，又干又硬，肯定放了好几天。
en: This bread is {stale}; it must be a few days old.

zh: 牛奶已经变酸了，别喝。
en: The milk has gone {sour|off|bad}; don't drink it.

zh: 不加糖的话，这咖啡对我来说太苦了。
en: The coffee is too {bitter} for me without sugar.

zh: 这个米饭有点淡，没什么味道，需要多放点调料。
en: The rice dish is a bit {bland|tasteless|plain}; it needs more seasoning.

zh: 这汤太咸了，你是不是放了两次盐？
en: The soup is too {salty}; did you add salt twice?

zh: 咖啡端上来的时候只是温的，不够热。
en: My coffee was only {lukewarm|warm|tepid} when it arrived.

zh: 我不要甜点了，谢谢，我吃饱了。
en: No dessert for me, thanks. I'm {full|stuffed}.

zh: 什么时候吃晚饭？我饿坏了。
en: When's dinner? I'm {starving|starved|famished}.

zh: 真好吃，谢谢你做饭。
en: That was {delicious|tasty|yummy|lovely}; thanks for cooking.

zh: 这份炸鱼薯条对我来说太油腻了。
en: The fish and chips were too {greasy|oily} for me.

zh: 这家店的分量给得很足，一份够两个人吃。
en: The portions here are really {generous|big|large|huge}; one dish feeds two.

zh: 我吃不了辣，可以给我微辣的吗？
en: I can't handle spicy food; can I get the {mild} version?
